benchmark_execution.description: Orchestrates end-to-end benchmark runs by coordinating scenario data loading, model adaptation, metric evaluation, and result presentation. Manages execution workflows across single and multi-GPU environments.

nodes.label: Load Scenarios & Data

nodes.description: Retrieves benchmark scenarios and test data. Preprocesses and augments data as needed. Supports diverse medical and general-purpose datasets.

nodes.description: Defines benchmark configurations including model selection, adapter settings, and evaluation parameters. Factory functions generate task-specific run specs.

nodes.label: Compute Metrics

nodes.label: Present Results

nodes.label: Infrastructure & Utilities

nodes.description: Provides tokenization, proxy services, window management, and logging. Enables distributed execution and remote service communication.

model_adaptation.description: Enables flexible model input preparation through adapters and data augmentation. Transforms raw instances into model-ready prompts while applying perturbations for robustness testing.

nodes.label: Receive Benchmark Instances

nodes.description: Accepts benchmark instances containing input text, references, and metadata from scenarios.

nodes.label: Select Adaptation Strategy
nodes.title: Adapter factory
nodes.description: Routes instances to appropriate adapter based on task type (generation, classification, multiple-choice) and model requirements.

nodes.label: Construct Model Prompts
nodes.title: Prompt building
nodes.description: Formats instances into model-specific prompts, handling in-context examples, instructions, and token constraints.

nodes.label: Apply Data Augmentations

nodes.description: Applies text transformations (typos, contractions, dialect shifts, gender terms) to test model robustness across input variations.

nodes.label: Emit Adapted Prompts

nodes.description: Returns model-ready prompts with optional augmented variants for inference and evaluation.

groups.label: Adaptation Pipeline

evaluation_and_metrics.title: Evaluation and Metrics
evaluation_and_metrics.description: Computes performance metrics, generates visualizations, and produces evaluation reports for benchmark runs. Integrates metric calculation, annotation workflows, and result presentation into a cohesive evaluation pipeline.

nodes.label: Calculate Performance Metrics
nodes.title: Metric Computation
nodes.description: Computes quantitative metrics (accuracy, BLEU, F1, etc.) on model outputs. Supports classification, generation, summarization, and image quality assessment across diverse task types.

nodes.label: Manage Annotations
nodes.title: Annotation Workflow
nodes.description: Orchestrates human and automated annotation processes. Handles annotator selection, result aggregation, and quality control for evaluation tasks.

nodes.label: Aggregate Results

nodes.description: Combines metrics and annotations into structured result sets. Prepares data for downstream visualization and reporting.

nodes.label: Generate Visualizations
nodes.title: Visualization Generation
nodes.description: Creates plots, charts, and interactive dashboards. Renders performance comparisons, trend analysis, and robustness summaries for human review.

nodes.label: Produce Evaluation Reports
nodes.title: Report Generation
nodes.description: Synthesizes metrics, visualizations, and metadata into comprehensive evaluation reports. Outputs JSON, HTML, and summary documents for stakeholders.

Enables token counting, model communication, context window handling, and logging across the system.
